description: A flaw has been found in H3C ICG2000 Unified Communication Gateway 2023. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /wnm/check.j of the component Web Management Module. Executing a manipulation can lead to missing authentication. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version R9141PXX is capable of addressing this issue. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component. The vendor confirms: "We have confirmed this issue is a known issue and has been fixed in R9141PXX versions."
